name: insight-os
description: Evidence-linked customer context, sales coaching, market intelligence, and conversion research backed by the read-only Insight OS MCP catalog.

interface.shortDescription: Turn customer-call evidence into scoped sales and market intelligence.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the read-only Insight OS capability catalog and adds focused workflows for pre-call customer context, sales coaching, market intelligence, outcome-cohort comparison, and evidence-backed claim verification. Authorization, row scope, PII redaction, and cohort privacy remain enforced by Insight OS on every tool call.
defaultPrompt: Chuẩn bị context khách hàng và cuộc gọi gần nhất.
Chọn ưu tiên coaching và call mẫu cho buổi 1:1.
So sánh khách chốt với chưa mua để tìm nhu cầu nổi bật.
